quarterly_data.quarter: FSP Technology press release: FSP Group Unveils Comprehensive U3 Ultra-Slim Adapter (10-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FSP expanded its U3 (Ultra Slim) adapter series to 90W-460W: models in mass production are 90W, 120W, 135W, 150W, 180W, 250W, 330W and 420W, and a 460W flagship model is scheduled for mass production in Q1 2027. The adapters are about 1 inch (25.4 mm) thick, with a volume reduction of up to 50% versus standard adapters of equivalent wattage and over 90% conversion efficiency, for gaming laptops, mini-PCs, docking stations and POS terminals.
quarterly_data.figure: 460W model mass production Q1 2027; up to 50% volume reduction
